incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC1234567 fired — service=embeddings-eu, symptom=high 5xx rate (15% over 5m). Auto-escalate=true. Notifying #incidents and oncall.

pagerbot: Page INC1234567 sent to oncall. Routing to -> morgan (primary). Escalation window: 7m.

morgan: ACK — taking it. Jumping on bridge now :raised_hand:

katie: joining bridge, opening temporary bridge -> https://meet.redwood/bridge/3101234567

raj: quick ask — any customer-facing impact yet? rough estimate of affected requests?

morgan: seeing 502s from upstream batch workers, spike started ~5:12 UTC. sample log:```
ERROR embeddings/worker.py:503 - UpstreamTimeoutError for job_id=job_9f2a; status=502; retries=0
TRACE kvcache: eviction rate spike, key_evictions=2300/5m
```

andre: might be KV cache eviction causing cascade. If throughput is high, scale pool first then check evictions. Run:```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/embeddings-pool --replicas=6
```

morgan: running scale now...```
Scaled deployment "embeddings-pool" from 4 to 6 replicas
```

incident-bot: PD update: INC1234567 acked by morgan. Next escalation to level2 in 7m if not resolved.

raj: runbook check — step 1: drain the worst node, step 2: enable read-only fallback, step 3: throttle ingest. Any recent deploys?

morgan: no deploys in last 2 hours. telemetry shows a batch job surge + kvcache evictions. Taking runbook step 2: enabling fallback. Command:```bash
POST /api/admin/cache/fallback -d '{"service":"embeddings","mode":"read-only"}'
```

morgan: fallback enabled, traffic routed to read-only cache. Monitoring errors.

katie: CS note — payment-service retry loop observed, ~3 customers reported errors via support. CS notified and we sent ETA placeholder.

andre: good call. If errors drop, keep scaled replicas for 10m then slowly revert. Also add a short-lived circuit-breaker for upstreams.

morgan: latest metrics: 5xx rate down to ~4% over last 2m, p95 latency steady. Holding on scaling for now.

katie: posting customer update: "We mitigated a backend error affecting a small percentage of requests; retries now succeeding. Engineering investigating root cause; no action needed from customers."

raj: nice. please ping here when stable for 15m so we can close PD. Also capture root cause in ticket.

incident-bot: PD note: escalation cancelled (ack still by morgan). Will auto-resolve if no regression in 30m.

andre: :thumbsup: great work. If any regression, escalate to SRE lead immediately.

katie: closing bridge in 12m unless we see a spike.

morgan: will follow up with timeline + RCA draft.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from katie, :eyes: from raj)
